text: Residents have contacted me concerned about the safety on Muir Ave near Islington Ave. Recent Vision Zero markings have narrowed the available roadway at the intersection and with cars parking nearly to the intersection it has created a dangerous situation. I am recommending limiting parking on Muir Ave.
The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited stopping at all times on both sides of Muir Avenue between Knox Avenue and Islington Avenue.
